lamps.steady: System malfunction in airbag or seat belt pretensioners. Have it inspected by an authorized Maruti Suzuki workshop immediately.
Normal bulb check when turning ignition ON.
lamps.flashing: Problem with key or immobilizer system. Turn ignition to LOCK and back to ON, or visit a workshop.

lamps.steady: Fuel tank is nearly empty. Fill the fuel tank immediately.
Parking brake engaged, low brake fluid, or system failure. Stop safely and check brake fluid or consult a workshop.
Problem with the ABS system. Stop safely, restart engine, and have system inspected if light remains on.
Insufficient engine oil pressure. Stop immediately, turn off engine, check oil level, and contact a workshop.
Problem with the battery charging system. Have it inspected immediately by an authorized workshop.
Driver or front passenger seat belt is not fastened. Fasten the seat belt.
lamps.flashing: Driver or front passenger seat belt is unbuckled while driving. Fasten the seat belt.

lamps.lamp: Rear passenger's seat belt reminder light
lamps.steady: Rear passengers have not fastened their seat belts. Fasten seat belts.
Fault in emission control or Auto Gear Shift system. Have vehicle inspected at an authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: Engine misfire detected, which can damage catalytic converter. Stop vehicle immediately in a safe place.

lamps.steady: Fault in Auto Gear Shift system. Stop in a safe place and contact an authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: Clutch temperature is too high or system fault present. Stop safely and let system cool down.

lamps.steady: One or more doors or tailgate are not completely closed. Close all doors properly.
Power steering system may not be working properly. Have it inspected by an authorized workshop.

lamps.lamp: High engine coolant temperature warning light
lamps.steady: Engine is overheating. Stop in a safe place, idle engine, and follow overheating procedures.
lamps.flashing: Engine is running hot. Avoid driving conditions that lead to actual overheating.

lamps.steady: Front fog lights are turned on and operating.

lamps.flashing: Left/right turn signal or hazard lights active. Fast flashing indicates turn signal system fault.

lamps.steady: Headlight main beams (high beams) are turned on.

lamps.flashing: If blinking while ignition is ON, there may be a problem with security system. Have it inspected.

lamps.steady: Prompts driver to depress brake pedal for Auto Gear Shift operation.
Engine has automatically stopped via ENG A-STOP system.
ENG A-STOP system is turned off by switch.
lamps.flashing: Problem with ENG A-STOP system. Have system inspected by an authorized workshop.

lamps.steady: Problem with hill hold control system. Have vehicle inspected at an authorized workshop.
Fault in ESP systems (other than ABS). Have system inspected by an authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: Stability control or traction control system is actively operating. Drive carefully.

lamps.steady: ESP systems (other than ABS) have been manually turned off using ESP OFF switch.
